note: Primary picks from kit/research/parts-research.json (five categories, each independently verified; where a verifier corrected a value, the corrected value is used). Prices are typical US street prices on the date above and move often. Planning totals use 'unit_usd'.

items.role: The two screens (identical pair; buy both from one retailer, same batch)
items.product: Samsung ViewFinity S6 S60UD 27" QHD IPS, 100 Hz, USB-C 90 W
items.why: Thinnest and lightest option (612.9 x 367.7 x 41.6 mm, 3.6 kg), VESA 100, flat boxy back, and Samsung publishes a to-scale 3D model so the printed shroud can fit precisely.

swap.note: $190-330 depending on deals; 44.9 mm deep and 4.9 kg, so the shroud is regenerated for it

items.role: Drives both screens + charges the laptop from one USB-C
items.product: Plugable UD-6950PDH USB-C dual 4K DisplayLink dock (100 W charging)
items.why: Works with any USB-C laptop, Mac (including base M1/M2) or Windows. Needs the free DisplayLink driver; video is compressed, fine for work, no HDCP.

upgrade.note: Thunderbolt 4/USB4 laptops get native, uncompressed video; DisplayLink fallback for base M1/M2

items.role: The sprung USB-C plug in the cradle (one end of the dock's host cable; never a male-to-female extension)
items.product: Newnex USB4 cable, C-male straight to C-male 90-degree side-exit, 1 m, 240 W
items.why: Small side-exit head with a published mechanical drawing (12.35 x 6.50 x 15.51 mm), so the floating carriage can be designed around it.

swap.product: Plugable Thunderbolt 4 cable, right-angle, 0.8 m, 240 W

items.role: Self-centring float for the plug carriage (4 used)
items.product: McMaster-Carr compression spring, music wire, 0.375 in long
items.price_note: pack; McMaster pages could not be checked automatically, confirm specs in a browser before ordering

items.role: 75% low-profile wireless keyboard (Bluetooth x3 + 2.4 GHz + USB-C)
items.product: Keychron K3 Ultra 8K wireless mechanical keyboard
items.why: 320.6 x 126 mm, 20-25.5 mm tall, Mac and Windows keycaps, ABS bottom (Qi-transparent).

swap.product: ZAGG Pro Keyboard 12 (charges wirelessly by itself, no receiver needed)

items.role: Makes the keyboard charge wirelessly: thin Qi receiver plugged into its USB-C port, folded flat underneath
items.product: NILLKIN Magic Tag wireless charging receiver, Type-C (Short)

swap.product: not needed with the ZAGG keyboard

items.role: Wireless mouse that charges natively on a Qi pad
items.product: Lenovo Multi-Device Wireless Mouse (X9 Edition)
items.why: Native Qi, 59 x 101 x 34 mm, 75 g, Bluetooth x2 + 2.4 GHz.

upgrade.product: Razer Cobra HyperSpeed + Razer Wireless Charging Puck

items.role: Wireless chargers fitted intact under the keyboard and mouse pockets
items.product: Anker 313 Wireless Charger (Pad)
items.why: Certified Qi with foreign-object detection; 100 x 100 x 11.2 mm; micro-USB 5 V/2 A.

items.role: Felt mat for work mode (optional)
items.product: Oakywood Felt & Cork Desk Mat 90 x 30, Anthracite

swap.product: any 800 x 300 mm felt desk mat

items.role: The only mains connection: lives inside the base, one cord to the wall
items.product: Tripp Lite by Eaton 6-outlet power strip, right-angle outlets, 24 in, 8 ft cord
items.why: UL 1363, 609.6 x 40.9 x 31.8 mm, outlets 144 mm apart; clips screw to printed bosses (never drill the strip).

items.role: Right-angle mains cords from the strip to each monitor (confirm the monitor inlet is C14 on arrival)
items.product: Tripp Lite heavy-duty cord, right-angle NEMA 5-15P to C13, 2 ft

items.role: Powers the low-voltage loads (charging pads, amber lights, sensors)
items.product: Monoprice 100 W USB-C 4-port GaN desktop charger
items.note: Final port plan is part of the wiring design (still to do); its documented multi-port power split must be respected.

items.role: USB-C PD trigger: 12 V for the amber lighting bus
